implReport.summary:
The play views now work on top of the real renderers: possession, observer and colony view, picking, markers and dig plans.

**Tunnel shot (the gate defect).** It is fixed and verified in the browser. In the queen-sized 1 BU shaft the camera now sits 1.25–2.5 L behind the queen. She is drawn at full opacity, the walls are not dithered away and no sky shows. Before, the camera sat 0.23 L away with a dithered view of the sky.

There were four root causes:
- The carve field's cavity distance saturates at 0.5 BU. A camera collision sphere of 0.5 BU (the queen's) therefore never fits inside a tunnel. Collision traces now use at most 0.35 BU; the GDD's clearance guarantee (f ≥ 0.5 R) is unchanged.
- One straight trace from the pivot hit the wall at every bend. The tunnel boom now checks collision along the ant's own trail, keeps the camera near the tunnel's middle, pushes trail points off ledges and prefers a spot that still sees the ant (never closer than 1.2 L).
- The 0.8 L occlusion capsule was wider than the shaft. It is now a narrow cone that ends 0.5 L short of the ant (one-line edit in the nest wall shader).
- `crevice` forced that cutaway everywhere. It now does so only above ground.

**Other camera additions:**
- A rate limiter (20 L/s relative to the pivot, except where the clearance guard must act) stops frame-to-frame jumps.
- A squeezed orbit in a low chamber leans on the ant's trail behind it.
- Pinch fallback (camera over the ant) and an optional ceiling-comfort mode (default off).
- The camera snaps behind the ant after a teleport or a jump of more than 3 L.
- When an ant is possessed inside a tunnel with no trail yet, the camera picks the freest direction behind her.
- A view hand-over whose straight path would pass through soil uses a dip-fade instead of a flight.

**Observer.** Hover highlight under the cursor; click to select (repeat clicks cycle overlapping ants); click-hold, double-click or E to possess; F to follow an ant or a creature; right-click to deselect. The HUD can read the selection through `game.viewsLayer.inspectTarget` (also `hoverTarget`); the shape is `{kind, id, pos}`.

**Colony view.**
- The slice can now reach the deepest chamber.
- X-ray shows ants and brood as dots and labels each chamber with its type.
- Marker tool: place, move (Shift+click), delete, undo and cap checks for forage, avoid, rally, move-brood and move-queen.
- Dig planner: Chamber, Tunnel, Shaft and Entrance templates; S/M/L size; 15° rotation; anchoring on the cut face or a wall; the nest module's own validation shown live; warnings need a second click; sends `planDig`.
- Ghosts are drawn by `src/render/fx/markers`: dashed yellow when valid, amber when there are warnings, red cross-hatch with the reason text when refused. Existing plans are outlined by status.

**End-to-end script.** `tests/e2e/views.mjs` passes with no console errors and 15 screenshots, all looked at. It runs on the test world (flat terrain with the standard wall, table and small nest), not a generated world.

**Full test suite.** It did not finish within 50 minutes at load average ~20. All failures it printed before timing out are outside my paths.

Editing a placed plan (priority, pause, resume) has no view interaction: Delete cancels it, and priority can only be chosen before placing.
Ceiling comfort is a rig option (default off) but not a persisted setting: the settings schema is not mine.
Terrain and primitive occlusion dithering is not done (render-integration's, per the addendum). Only nest walls use the new cone.
In x-ray, chambers are labelled with their type as text, not glyphs.
GDD 08 E18 (200 ms reduced-motion crossfade) is not met: GDD 01 §2, which owns the camera, says 0.3 s and that is what is implemented.
GDD 08 E11 (alert click-through moves the camera to a chamber) needs ui-panels plus a views camera call; not done.

Deviation note for GDD 01 §6.5 (addendum ruling):
- Rule 3: the 0.8 L capsule becomes a cone from the camera (radius 0.35 × 0.35 L) to 0.5 L short of the thorax (radius 0.35 L), so only walls between camera and ant are dithered.
- Rule 4: `crevice` forces the cutaway and the 0.5 opacity cap only above ground.
- No sky backdrop was needed: with the camera on the trail the shaft is never dithered (04 shots).

Other camera deviations (GDD 01 §6.1–6.4):
- Collision sphere capped at 0.35 BU because the cavity field saturates at 0.5 BU; clearance guarantee unchanged.
- crevice distance: 1.8 L default, 1.2–2.5 L zoom (GDD: 1.2 L fixed).
- The tunnel boom is checked along the trail with a mid-gap raise, ledge relaxation and a line-of-sight preference (≥ 1.2 L).
- Pull-in is rate-limited to 20 L/s unless the clearance guard must act (GDD: immediate).
- A squeezed orbit blends toward the trail (path assist).
- Snap behind the ant after a jump of more than 3 L.
- View hand-overs whose path crosses solid dip-fade (GDD: colony rise/descent is a flight).
Contradiction recorded: GDD 08 §2.4 and E18 say reduced-motion camera transitions are a 200 ms crossfade; GDD 01 §2 (camera owner) says 0.3 s. Followed GDD 01 per the precedence rule.
The entrance tool uses the dig planner (`planDig` kind entrance, GDD 03 §14.2) and places no 'entrance' marker, so no marker without a plan is left behind.

- Covered here: GDD 01 E12 (worker in a 2 BU tunnel, 60 frames at 60 fps, unit test), E13 (ground -> table leg -> underside -> top, comfort on and off; the climb takes ~6 s, not 60 s), E14 (up-vector timing), E20 (Tab order, e2e).

findings.title: Observer follow camera goes inside solid in the queen's shaft (GDD 6.1/6.6)
findings.detail: The follow centre is 0.5 L above the subject. In a queen-sized 1 BU shaft that point lies inside the soil. The trace from it then returns 0, so followDist becomes 0 and the camera sits at the centre, inside solid. Reproduce with views.verify.test.ts 'the observer FOLLOWING the queen down the shaft…': it walks the queen down the test nest with the real field. Three of 698 frames fail, the worst at f = -0.61 mm against the required 0.6 mm. Players reach this state on X (release) or Esc from the colony view while the ant is in a tunnel. GDD 6.1 applies the f ≥ 0.5 R rule to every camera, and §6.6 says the follow camera uses the same collision as §6.2. It needs a clearance guard (for example the possession rig's MotionGuard) or a pivot clamped into free space.

findings.title: Release hand-over does not keep the camera: the observer orbit swings to a stale yaw
findings.detail: GDD 01 §2 says 'X: release; camera stays, becomes follow-orbit on the released ant'. setView('observer', subject) calls follow(), which keeps the observer rig's old yaw and pitch, so the 0.4 s flight ends somewhere unrelated. Reproduce with views.verify.test.ts 'after the release the follow orbit looks at the ant from where the possession camera was'. The view direction changes by 90° with no orbit input and by 150° after a 120° orbit. Fix: start the follow orbit from the pose being left (yaw and pitch from camera minus ant, distance clamped to 2..80 L).

findings.title: Shift+wheel with a marker tool changes the marker radius and moves the slice plane in the same frame
findings.where: src/game/views/colony/colonyControl.ts:46-53; src/game/views/viewDirector.ts:238-242 and viewsLayer.ts:94 (colonyCapture only when the planner is active)
findings.detail: With the forage, avoid or rally tool active, Shift+wheel changes the radius in colonyKeys. The ColonyRig still receives cv-slice-up/down and moves the plane 10 BU, because Shift also applies the fast multiplier. Reproduce with views.verify.test.ts 'Shift+wheel with a marker tool…': planeY goes from -40 to -80 mm. Either set colonyCapture for any tool that takes Shift+wheel, or use a different binding for the radius. GDD 08 §4.3 sets the radius by dragging.

findings.title: The committed e2e no longer shows what acceptance criterion 2 requires: the founding intro card hides the subject in every shot, yet the script still passes
findings.detail: With the founding flow now in the checkout, a test-mode game keeps the 'Black garden ant' intro card on screen, because the manual clock never advances it. All 15 screenshots of the committed script have the card over the ant (test-output/views-review/01…12). The run still reports ok:true, so the script no longer protects the visual criterion. I fixed it in a copy (test-output/views-review2/review.mjs) by adding `await g(() => window.__game.command({ type: 'openingSkipIntro' })); await g(() => window.__game.step(1));` after newGame. With that line all shots are readable and every assertion passes.

findings.title: A refused marker move loses the selection
findings.detail: move() removes the marker and places it again. If the sim refuses the new spot (for example move-brood into the food chamber, reason 'invalid'), the tool puts the marker back under a new id, but selectedId still points to the removed id. Delete then does nothing and the ring is no longer highlighted. Reproduce with views.verify.test.ts 'a refused marker move keeps the marker and a valid selection'.

findings.title: Ctrl+Z after a move does nothing
findings.detail: A move is not pushed to the undo stack. Undo then pops the earlier 'placed' entry, whose marker id is now dead, so nothing happens but the call returns true. Reproduce with views.verify.test.ts 'Ctrl+Z after a move undoes something': the marker state is the same before and after. GDD 08 §4.3 says Ctrl+Z undoes the last placement or removal, and a move is both.

findings.title: The free observer camera cannot move at all when it starts closer than its radius to a surface
findings.detail: Each axis move traces with radius r from the current position. When f(pos) < r the trace returns 0 in every direction, so the camera is stuck even when flying away from the wall. Reproduce with views.verify.test.ts 'a free camera closer than its radius to the ground…': it starts at f = 0.8 R and is still at y = 0.96 mm after 1 s of flying up. The camera can get there through freeFlyAt(current pose) right after the in-solid follow frames above, or through camera.setPose. Moves that increase f should be allowed.

findings.title: Marker renderer: label textures leak, and the whole scene is rebuilt every sim tick
findings.detail: Label CanvasTextures are cached by text and never freed until dispose(). The ghost text contains the live volume (e.g. 'nursery chamber: 73 BU³'), so hovering over walls adds a new GPU texture for each distinct value without limit. Separately, the version key includes sim.state.tick, so the renderer throws away and recreates all line geometries and materials, and re-uploads the nest ghost instances, about 10 times per second at 1x in every view, possession included where nothing is drawn. Fixes: keep the tick out of the key unless plan progress changed, and give the label cache a small LRU.

findings.title: E on overlapping ants possesses the hovered one, not the one selected by click cycling
findings.detail: possessable(st.hover) is checked before st.selected. If the player cycles with repeated clicks to the second of two overlapping ants and presses E, the first (hovered) ant is possessed. GDD 01 §3.2 says 'E on the selected or hovered ant', and the point of cycling is to choose among overlaps, so E should prefer the selection when it is under the cursor.

findings.title: Planner reports 'created' for a plan that is only queued
findings.detail: In real time, h.command returns applied:false. confirm() then returns outcome 'created' with planId -1, and colonyClick closes the tool. If the sim refuses the plan on the next tick, the player is left with no tool and no plan, and only the generic refusal toast.

findings.title: GDD 03 §14.2 edit rows missing and not all reported
findings.detail: There is no designateChamber (chamber type change) and no sealEntrance or reopenEntrance on clicking a chamber or entrance, and nothing in src/game or src/ui sends them. The report lists plan priority, pause and resume as not done, but does not mention chamber type change or seal/reopen. The orchestrator should assign these, possibly to ui-panels through the inspect card.

findings.title: Smaller GDD 01 gaps in the camera
findings.detail: Not implemented: footstep tremor shake (§6.1); the game-level `camera-state-changed` event (App. C); and clearance during transition flights, where blendPoses positions are not guarded and crossesSolid traces with radius 0 (§6.1 applies to every rendered frame). The ghost reason label is very large: in shot 09 it spans about 75 % of the 1280 px width and overlaps the HUD.
